description: Asks, live, whether ONE client really is the crawler it claims to be — a fresh reverse-DNS lookup against the addresses this site saw it use, falling back to the operator’s published IP ranges. Use it when a row is flagged as an impostor and you want a second answer before deciding, or when a client was flagged long ago and may have been fixed since. Only works on a client claiming an identity from `verifiers` in read-clients: nothing else has anything to check against. A verdict of 0 means the lookup gave no usable answer and the client’s standing verdict is left alone — an inconclusive check never overwrites what was known. ⚠️ It makes real DNS requests, so it is rate-limited; a burst is refused rather than queued.

ua.description: The client’s user-agent, exactly as read-clients returned it.

name: agentimus-recheck-client

checked.description: How many addresses were looked up.

status.description: checked = an answer; no-ip = this site kept no address for the client, so there was nothing to look up.

verdict.description: 0 = inconclusive (nothing was changed), 1 = confirmed genuine, 2 = confirmed impostor.

title: Re-check a client’s identity
